sentences.text: Nicolas admire le travail raffiné de ces bijoux en or.
sentences.en: Nicolas admires the refined craftsmanship of this gold jewelry.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 이 금 장신구의 섬세한 솜씨에 감탄해요.

sentences.text: Inès a choisi un papier peint raffiné pour la chambre d'amis.
sentences.en: Inès chose an elegant wallpaper for the guest room.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 손님방에 고급스러운 벽지를 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Un visiteur un peu snob a corrigé la prononciation de Nicolas devant le groupe.
sentences.en: A slightly snobbish visitor corrected Nicolas's pronunciation in front of the group.
sentences.ko: 좀 잘난 척하는 관람객이 단체 앞에서 니콜라의 발음을 고쳐 줬어요.

sentences.text: Selon Inès, l'agent immobilier était un peu snob avec ses grands mots.
sentences.en: According to Inès, the estate agent was a bit snobbish with his big words.
sentences.ko: 이네스 말로는 부동산 중개인이 거창한 말로 좀 잘난 척했대요.

sentences.text: Le café du musée sert un sandwich infâme à un prix exorbitant.
sentences.en: The museum café serves an awful sandwich at an outrageous price.
sentences.ko: 박물관 카페는 터무니없는 값에 형편없는 샌드위치를 팔아요.

sentences.text: En arrachant la moquette, Inès a découvert une odeur infâme.
sentences.en: While ripping up the carpet, Inès discovered a vile smell.
sentences.ko: 카펫을 뜯어내자 이네스는 지독한 냄새를 맡았어요.

sentences.text: La nouvelle exposition de Nicolas s'intitule « Lumières du Nord ».
sentences.en: Nicolas's new exhibition is called "Northern Lights".
sentences.ko: 니콜라의 새 전시 제목은 「북쪽의 빛」이에요.

sentences.text: Inès tient un blog sur ses travaux intitulé « La maison qui craque ».
sentences.en: Inès keeps a blog about her renovation called "The Creaking House".
sentences.ko: 이네스는 「삐걱대는 집」이라는 제목으로 공사 블로그를 써요.

sentences.text: Le dépliant générique ne dit presque rien sur les tableaux de la salle bleue.
sentences.en: The generic leaflet says almost nothing about the paintings in the blue room.
sentences.ko: 일반 안내 책자에는 파란 전시실 그림에 대한 설명이 거의 없어요.

sentences.text: Inès a acheté des ampoules génériques, bien moins chères que les autres.
sentences.en: Inès bought generic bulbs, much cheaper than the others.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 훨씬 싼 일반 상표 전구를 샀어요.

sentences.text: La conservatrice est très exigeante sur l'éclairage des vitrines.
sentences.en: The curator is very demanding about the lighting in the display cases.
sentences.ko: 큐레이터는 진열장 조명에 아주 까다로워요.

sentences.text: L'électricien d'Inès est exigeant, mais son travail est impeccable.
sentences.en: Inès's electrician is demanding, but his work is flawless.
sentences.ko: 이네스네 전기 기사는 까다롭지만 일 처리는 완벽해요.

sentences.text: Un enfant a voulu fourrer son doigt dans la bouche de la statue.
sentences.en: A child tried to stick his finger in the statue's mouth.
sentences.ko: 한 아이가 조각상 입에 손가락을 넣으려고 했어요.

sentences.text: Inès a fourré tous les vieux journaux dans un grand sac.
sentences.en: Inès stuffed all the old newspapers into a big bag.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 낡은 신문을 전부 큰 자루에 쑤셔 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Après l'exposition, l'équipe doit démonter toutes les vitrines en deux jours.
sentences.en: After the exhibition, the team has to take down all the display cases in two days.
sentences.ko: 전시가 끝나면 팀은 이틀 만에 진열장을 전부 해체해야 해요.

sentences.text: Inès a passé le samedi à démonter les vieux placards de la cuisine.
sentences.en: Inès spent Saturday taking apart the old kitchen cupboards.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 토요일 내내 낡은 부엌 찬장을 뜯어냈어요.

sentences.text: Nicolas espère éveiller la curiosité des enfants avec des ateliers de dessin.
sentences.en: Nicolas hopes to spark the children's curiosity with drawing workshops.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 그림 그리기 강좌로 아이들의 호기심을 깨우고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Le grincement de l'escalier a fini par éveiller les soupçons d'Inès sur les poutres.
sentences.en: The creaking of the stairs ended up making Inès suspicious about the beams.
sentences.ko: 계단 삐걱거림에 결국 이네스는 들보를 의심하게 됐어요.

sentences.text: Le musée prête une statue et attend en retour une œuvre de valeur équivalente.
sentences.en: The museum is lending a statue and expects a work of equivalent value in return.
sentences.ko: 박물관은 조각상을 빌려주고 그만한 가치의 작품을 받기로 해요.

sentences.text: Inès cherche un carrelage équivalent à celui d'origine.
sentences.en: Inès is looking for tiles equivalent to the original ones.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 원래 것과 같은 타일을 찾고 있어요.

sentences.text: La grande galerie offre une vue grandiose sur les jardins.
sentences.en: The great gallery offers a magnificent view of the gardens.
sentences.ko: 대전시실에서는 정원이 장대하게 내려다보여요.

sentences.text: Inès voulait un grand lustre, mais le résultat est trop grandiose pour le salon.
sentences.en: Inès wanted a big chandelier, but the result is too grand for the living room.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 큰 샹들리에를 원했지만 거실에 비해 너무 거창해요.

sentences.text: Nicolas a découvert une tache immonde sur un tapis du dix-huitième siècle.
sentences.en: Nicolas found a revolting stain on an eighteenth-century rug.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 십팔 세기 양탄자에서 끔찍한 얼룩을 발견했어요.

sentences.text: La cave était dans un état immonde quand Inès a acheté la maison.
sentences.en: The cellar was in a disgusting state when Inès bought the house.
sentences.ko: 이네스가 집을 샀을 때 지하실은 끔찍한 상태였어요.

sentences.text: L'erreur de date sur l'étiquette est flagrante.
sentences.en: The date mistake on the label is glaring.
sentences.ko: 설명표의 날짜 오류가 너무 뻔해요.

sentences.text: L'expert a relevé un défaut flagrant dans l'installation électrique.
sentences.en: The inspector noted an obvious defect in the electrical wiring.
sentences.ko: 검사원은 전기 배선에서 명백한 결함을 찾아냈어요.

sentences.text: Nicolas doit ajuster la hauteur de chaque cadre au millimètre près.
sentences.en: Nicolas has to adjust the height of each frame to the millimeter.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 액자 높이를 밀리미터 단위까지 맞춰야 해요.

sentences.text: Inès a dû ajuster les portes, qui frottaient contre le parquet.
sentences.en: Inès had to adjust the doors, which were rubbing against the floorboards.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 마룻바닥에 쓸리는 문을 손봐야 했어요.

sentences.text: La ressemblance entre les deux portraits a intrigué les visiteurs.
sentences.en: The likeness between the two portraits intrigued the visitors.
sentences.ko: 두 초상화가 닮은 게 관람객들의 눈길을 끌었어요.

sentences.text: Inès a été frappée par la ressemblance entre sa maison et celle de sa grand-mère.
sentences.en: Inès was struck by how much her house looked like her grandmother's.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 자기 집이 할머니 집과 너무 닮아서 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Le prix du billet, audioguide compris, reste raisonnable.
sentences.en: The ticket price, audio guide included, is still reasonable.
sentences.ko: 오디오 가이드를 포함해도 입장권 값은 적당해요.

sentences.text: Le devis du plombier, main-d'œuvre comprise, dépasse le budget d'Inès.
sentences.en: The plumber's quote, labor included, goes over Inès's budget.
sentences.ko: 인건비를 포함한 배관공 견적이 이네스의 예산을 넘어요.

sentences.text: Le documentaire sur le vol de la statue entretient le suspense jusqu'à la fin.
sentences.en: The documentary about the statue theft keeps up the suspense until the end.
sentences.ko: 조각상 도난을 다룬 다큐멘터리는 끝까지 긴장감을 놓지 않아요.

sentences.text: Inès attend les résultats de l'expertise de la toiture avec beaucoup de suspense.
sentences.en: Inès awaits the roof inspection results in great suspense.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 지붕 점검 결과를 조마조마하게 기다려요.

sentences.text: Un musicien joue une ballade ancienne dans la cour du musée.
sentences.en: A musician plays an old ballad in the museum courtyard.
sentences.ko: 음악가 한 명이 박물관 마당에서 옛 발라드를 연주해요.

sentences.text: Inès écoute une vieille ballade à la radio en ponçant les volets.
sentences.en: Inès listens to an old ballad on the radio while sanding the shutters.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 덧창을 사포질하며 라디오로 옛 발라드를 들어요.

sentences.text: La salle grecque expose une urne décorée de scènes de chasse.
sentences.en: The Greek room displays an urn decorated with hunting scenes.
sentences.ko: 그리스 전시실에는 사냥 장면이 그려진 항아리가 있어요.

sentences.text: Dans le grenier, Inès a trouvé une urne en terre cuite remplie de boutons.
sentences.en: In the attic, Inès found a terracotta urn full of buttons.
sentences.ko: 다락에서 이네스는 단추가 가득 든 토기 항아리를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Pour Nicolas, ces momies racontent le rêve d'immortalité des anciens.
sentences.en: For Nicolas, these mummies tell of the ancients' dream of immortality.
sentences.ko: 니콜라에게 이 미라들은 옛사람들의 불멸에 대한 꿈을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Inès plaisante en disant que ces travaux lui demanderont l'immortalité pour finir.
sentences.en: Inès jokes that she'd need immortality to finish this renovation.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 이 공사를 끝내려면 불사의 몸이 있어야겠다고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Le panneau explique les représailles qui ont suivi la révolte des paysans.
sentences.en: The panel explains the reprisals that followed the peasants' revolt.
sentences.ko: 안내판은 농민 봉기 뒤에 이어진 보복을 설명해요.

sentences.text: Inès n'ose pas se plaindre du bruit des voisins par peur des représailles.
sentences.en: Inès doesn't dare complain about the neighbors' noise for fear of reprisals.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 보복이 무서워 이웃 소음에 대해 불평을 못 해요.

sentences.text: Ce tableau a été commandé par une confrérie de tisserands.
sentences.en: This painting was commissioned by a weavers' guild.
sentences.ko: 이 그림은 직조공 조합의 주문으로 그려졌어요.

sentences.text: Les artisans du village forment une sorte de confrérie qui se recommande entre elle.
sentences.en: The village craftsmen form a kind of brotherhood whose members recommend one another.
sentences.ko: 마을 장인들은 서로 추천해 주는 일종의 동업 모임이에요.

sentences.text: Nicolas rit de l'absurdité de certaines questions posées par les touristes.
sentences.en: Nicolas laughs at how absurd some of the tourists' questions are.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 관광객들의 엉뚱한 질문에 웃음이 나요.

sentences.text: Inès dénonce l'absurdité des règles qui l'empêchent de changer ses fenêtres.
sentences.en: Inès denounces the absurdity of the rules that stop her changing her windows.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 창문을 못 바꾸게 하는 규정이 터무니없다고 비판해요.

sentences.text: La relique la plus fragile est gardée dans une vitrine climatisée.
sentences.en: The most fragile relic is kept in a climate-controlled case.
sentences.ko: 가장 약한 유물은 온습도 조절 진열장에 보관돼요.

sentences.text: Le vieux poêle en fonte est devenu une relique qu'Inès refuse de jeter.
sentences.en: The old cast-iron stove has become a relic that Inès refuses to throw out.
sentences.ko: 낡은 무쇠 난로는 이네스가 버리지 못하는 유물이 됐어요.

sentences.text: L'exposition montre la prospérité du port au temps des grandes foires.
sentences.en: The exhibition shows the port's prosperity in the age of the great fairs.
sentences.ko: 전시는 큰 장이 서던 시절 항구의 번영을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Les ornements de la façade datent d'une époque de grande prospérité.
sentences.en: The ornaments on the façade date from a time of great prosperity.
sentences.ko: 건물 앞면 장식은 크게 번영하던 시절의 것이에요.

sentences.text: Après une longue interruption, la visite guidée a pu reprendre.
sentences.en: After a long interruption, the guided tour was able to resume.
sentences.ko: 오래 중단됐던 가이드 투어가 다시 시작됐어요.

sentences.text: Une interruption d'eau a obligé Inès à aller se doucher chez son frère.
sentences.en: A water outage forced Inès to go and shower at her brother's.
sentences.ko: 단수 때문에 이네스는 오빠네 가서 샤워해야 했어요.

sentences.text: La panne d'alarme ressemblait à un sabotage, mais c'était un simple orage.
sentences.en: The alarm failure looked like sabotage, but it was just a storm.
sentences.ko: 경보기 고장은 고의적인 방해 같았지만 그냥 뇌우 때문이었어요.

sentences.text: Inès a d'abord cru à un sabotage en trouvant le compteur coupé.
sentences.en: Inès first thought it was sabotage when she found the meter switched off.
sentences.ko: 계량기가 꺼진 걸 보고 이네스는 처음엔 누가 일부러 그랬다고 생각했어요.

sentences.text: Dans la salle des jeux anciens, on voit une fléchette en os sculpté.
sentences.en: In the old games room, you can see a dart made of carved bone.
sentences.ko: 옛 놀이 전시실에는 뼈를 깎아 만든 다트가 있어요.

sentences.text: Dans le garage, Inès a trouvé une vieille cible avec une fléchette encore plantée.
sentences.en: In the garage, Inès found an old dartboard with one dart still stuck in it.
sentences.ko: 차고에서 이네스는 다트 하나가 아직 꽂힌 낡은 과녁을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Le consul est venu inaugurer l'exposition sur les marins du port.
sentences.en: The consul came to open the exhibition on the port's sailors.
sentences.ko: 영사가 항구 선원 전시 개막식에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Selon le notaire, la maison avait appartenu à un ancien consul.
sentences.en: According to the notary, the house had belonged to a former consul.
sentences.ko: 공증인 말로는 그 집이 옛 영사의 것이었대요.

sentences.text: Le musée prépare une rétrospective sur un dessinateur belge.
sentences.en: The museum is preparing a retrospective of a Belgian cartoonist.
sentences.ko: 박물관은 벨기에 만화가 회고전을 준비하고 있어요.

sentences.text: Inès a commandé des briques belges pour refaire le mur du jardin.
sentences.en: Inès ordered Belgian bricks to rebuild the garden wall.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 정원 담을 다시 쌓으려고 벨기에 벽돌을 주문했어요.

sentences.text: La légende raconte que ce manuscrit a survécu à l'incendie par la providence.
sentences.en: Legend has it that this manuscript survived the fire by providence.
sentences.ko: 전설에 따르면 이 필사본은 하늘의 도움으로 불길에서 살아남았대요.

sentences.text: Trouver un couvreur libre en plein mois d'août, pour Inès, c'est la providence.
sentences.en: For Inès, finding a free roofer in the middle of August is a godsend.
sentences.ko: 이네스에게 팔월 한복판에 일할 수 있는 지붕 기술자를 찾은 건 하늘이 도운 일이에요.

sentences.text: La salle consacrée aux arts de l'islam expose des carreaux de céramique bleue.
sentences.en: The room devoted to Islamic arts displays blue ceramic tiles.
sentences.ko: 이슬람 미술 전시실에는 파란 도자기 타일이 전시돼 있어요.

sentences.text: Le voisin d'Inès, professeur d'histoire, lui a prêté un livre sur l'art de l'islam.
sentences.en: Inès's neighbor, a history teacher, lent her a book on Islamic art.
sentences.ko: 역사 교사인 이웃이 이네스에게 이슬람 미술 책을 빌려줬어요.

sentences.text: Nicolas cherche une tournure plus simple pour le texte des étiquettes.
sentences.en: Nicolas is looking for a simpler way of putting it for the label text.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 설명표 글을 더 쉬운 표현으로 바꾸려고 해요.

sentences.text: Vu la tournure des travaux, Inès ne s'installera pas avant l'hiver.
sentences.en: Given the way the work is going, Inès won't move in before winter.
sentences.ko: 공사 돌아가는 꼴을 보니 이네스는 겨울 전에는 못 들어가요.

sentences.text: Une fanfare a joué dans le hall pour la nuit des musées.
sentences.en: A brass band played in the hall for museum night.
sentences.ko: 박물관의 밤 행사 때 홀에서 관악대가 연주했어요.

sentences.text: Le jour où le toit a été fini, le voisin a joué un air de fanfare à la trompette.
sentences.en: The day the roof was finished, the neighbor played a brass-band tune on the trumpet.
sentences.ko: 지붕이 끝난 날 이웃이 트럼펫으로 행진곡을 불었어요.

sentences.text: Le musée a reçu une injonction de rendre le tableau à ses héritiers.
sentences.en: The museum received an order to return the painting to its heirs.
sentences.ko: 박물관은 그림을 상속인에게 돌려주라는 명령을 받았어요.

sentences.text: La mairie a envoyé à Inès une injonction de réparer la clôture.
sentences.en: The town hall sent Inès an order to repair the fence.
sentences.ko: 시청이 이네스에게 울타리를 고치라는 명령서를 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Une pétition demande l'ouverture du musée le lundi.
sentences.en: A petition asks for the museum to open on Mondays.
sentences.ko: 월요일에도 박물관을 열어 달라는 청원이 올라왔어요.

sentences.text: Inès a signé la pétition des voisins pour sauver le vieux lavoir.
sentences.en: Inès signed the neighbors' petition to save the old washhouse.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 옛 빨래터를 지키자는 이웃들의 청원에 서명했어요.

sentences.text: Le musée prépare une grande célébration pour son centenaire.
sentences.en: The museum is preparing a big celebration for its centenary.
sentences.ko: 박물관은 개관 백 주년을 맞아 큰 기념 행사를 준비해요.

sentences.text: La fin du chantier a donné lieu à une petite célébration entre amis.
sentences.en: The end of the work was the occasion for a small celebration among friends.
sentences.ko: 공사가 끝나자 친구들끼리 조촐한 축하 자리를 가졌어요.

sentences.text: Le directeur précédent a été accusé de détournement de fonds.
sentences.en: The previous director was accused of embezzlement.
sentences.ko: 전임 관장은 공금 횡령 혐의를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Le détournement du ruisseau par l'ancien propriétaire a fragilisé les fondations.
sentences.en: The diversion of the stream by the previous owner weakened the foundations.
sentences.ko: 전 주인이 개울 물길을 돌리는 바람에 기초가 약해졌어요.

sentences.text: Nicolas a écrit une tribune pour défendre la gratuité des musées.
sentences.en: Nicolas wrote an opinion piece defending free museum entry.
sentences.ko: 니콜라는 박물관 무료 입장을 지지하는 기고문을 썼어요.

sentences.text: Inès a raconté son chantier dans une tribune du journal local.
sentences.en: Inès described her renovation in an opinion column in the local paper.
sentences.ko: 이네스는 지역 신문 기고란에 공사 이야기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Les amis du musée vont élire un nouveau président au printemps.
sentences.en: The museum's friends' association will elect a new president in the spring.
sentences.ko: 박물관 후원회는 봄에 새 회장을 뽑아요.

sentences.text: Les voisins viennent d'élire Inès à la tête de l'association du quartier.
sentences.en: The neighbors have just elected Inès head of the residents' association.
sentences.ko: 이웃들이 방금 이네스를 동네 모임 대표로 뽑았어요.
